title: Frugal colourings of graphs via sparse hypergraph colouring
summary: A proper colouring of a graph $G$ is $β$-frugal if every colour appears at most $β$ times in the neighbourhood of each vertex. Let $χ_β(G)$ denote the minimum number of colours required for a $β$-frugal colouring of $G$. For a fixed frugality $β$, Hind et al. showed that $χ_β(G) = \mathcal{O}(Δ(G)^{1 + 1/β})$, and a bipartite construction of Alon certifies the tightness of this upper bound up to a constant factor.
